description.value: Roy Henry Vickers Gallery is a world-renowned First Nations art gallery in Tofino built in 1986 by artist Roy Henry Vickers himself alongside close friends and family. The building is modelled after a traditional Northwest Coast longhouse with cedar-planked walls, and showcases limited edition prints, original paintings, and carvings that draw visitors from around the world. It is considered a cultural landmark in Tofino and a distinctive stop on BC's west coast.
